description: For the person's own confirmed appointment: tells the MCC desk they are running about 5, 10, 15, 20 or 30 minutes late, so the notary knows to wait. The appointment is not moved and nothing is promised: if the notary can't wait, the desk calls the person. Works from 3 hours before the start until 30 minutes after it. Confirm with the person first and pass confirm: true. Needs their private booking link.

code.description: Instead of link: the token= value from that link

confirm.description: true once the person has said to tell the desk

link.description: The person's private link: the manage link from a booking email (…/manage.html?ref=…&token=…). Or give ref and token separately.

ref.description: Instead of link: the booking number, e.g. MCC-AB12CD

name: running_late
title: Tell the desk the person is running late
